properties.description: Starts a vMedia OS installation for one Blade or Rack Unit. Resolves the organization, server, configuration, OS image, SCU/OSDU image, and install target by exact identity, concrete type, and organization permission. It does not prevalidate repository readiness, metadata compatibility, model support, or content combinations; the Intersight os.Install response is authoritative. Version 1 sends no Answers or AdditionalParameters, so configurations requiring values may be rejected. Only concrete install targets are accepted. Final name preflight and POST can race. HTTP 200 means accepted unless OperState is CompletedOk or Warning; CompletedError fails. Optional polling runs five times within 1-600 seconds. Inspect before retrying ambiguous mutation or poll failures. Content resolution and polling are inlined.
properties.display_name: Cisco Intersight - Start operating system installation

properties.script:
import sys
organizationMoid = sys.argv[1]
templates = sys.argv[2:]
if not organizationMoid or any(template.count("{organizationMoid}") != 1 for template in templates):
    raise ValueError("Every route template must contain exactly one organization placeholder")
routes = [template.replace("{organizationMoid}", organizationMoid) for template in templates]
if any("{" in route or "}" in route or organizationMoid not in route for route in routes):
    raise ValueError("A finalized route is unresolved")
serverApiUrl, configApiUrl, imageApiUrl, scuApiUrl, duplicateApiUrl = routes
helperReady = all(routes)
if not helperReady:
    raise ValueError("Validation did not produce its complete readiness contract.")

properties.description: Validates the three read-only content responses in one bounded helper using only exact cardinality, selector, concrete type, safe Moid, nonblank Name, and organization permission. It does not validate image combinations, repository metadata, source details, or model compatibility.
properties.display_name: Inspect exact OS installation content
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

resolverReady = False
resolverStatusCode = "500"
resolverStatusMessage = "OS installation content inspection did not complete."
resolverErrorMessage = resolverStatusMessage
resolverResultJson = json.dumps({"error":resolverStatusMessage,"requestAccepted":False}, separators=(",", ":"))
configMoid = ""
configResolution = ""
osImageMoid = ""
osImageResolution = ""
scuMoid = ""
scuResolution = ""

def inspect_resource(raw, kind, selector, organization_moid):
    payload = json.loads(raw)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError(kind + " response is not a JSON object")
    values = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        raise ValueError(kind + " response is missing Results")
    definitions = {
        "configuration": ("os.ConfigurationFile", "OS Configuration File"),
        "operating-system-image": ("softwarerepository.OperatingSystemFile", "Operating System Image"),
        "scu-image": ("firmware.ServerConfigurationUtilityDistributable", "SCU or OSDU Image"),
    }
    object_type, label = definitions[kind]

    def safe_moid(value):
        return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", value) is not None

    def organization_present(entries):
        return isinstance(entries, list) and any(
            isinstance(value, dict)
            and value.get("Moid") == organization_moid
            and value.get("ObjectType") in (None, "organization.Organization")
            for value in entries
        )

    resource_moid = ""
    resource_name = ""
    if len(values) == 0:
        status = "not-found"
        message = "No exact organization-permitted " + label + " matched Name or Moid."
    elif len(values) > 1:
        status = "ambiguous"
        message = "Multiple " + label + " resources matched Name or Moid."
    else:
        item = values[0]
        problems = []
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            problems.append(label + " result is not an object.")
        else:
            if item.get("Name") != selector and item.get("Moid") != selector:
                problems.append(label + " matches neither exact Name nor exact Moid.")
            if item.get("ObjectType") != object_type or item.get("ClassId") != object_type:
                problems.append(label + " discriminators are invalid.")
            if not safe_moid(item.get("Moid")):
                problems.append(label + " Moid is missing or unsafe.")
            if not isinstance(item.get("Name"), str) or not item.get("Name") or item.get("Name") != item.get("Name").strip():
                problems.append(label + " Name is missing or contains surrounding whitespace.")
            if not organization_present(item.get("PermissionResources")):
                problems.append(label + " does not retain the exact organization permission relationship.")
        if problems:
            status = "invalid"
            message = " ".join(problems)
        else:
            status = "exact"
            message = "Exactly one accessible " + label + " identity was validated; repository readiness and content compatibility are delegated to Intersight submission."
            resource_moid = item["Moid"]
            resource_name = item["Name"]

    return {
        "status": status,
        "message": message,
        "kind": kind,
        "objectType": object_type,
        "selector": selector,
        "resourceMoid": resource_moid or None,
        "resourceName": resource_name or None,
        "organizationMoid": organization_moid,
        "validationScope": "identity-type-and-organization",
        "readinessValidated": False,
        "compatibilityValidated": False,
    }

try:
    organizationMoid = sys.argv[7]
    configuration = inspect_resource(sys.argv[1], "configuration", sys.argv[4], organizationMoid)
    operatingSystemImage = inspect_resource(sys.argv[2], "operating-system-image", sys.argv[5], organizationMoid)
    scuImage = inspect_resource(sys.argv[3], "scu-image", sys.argv[6], organizationMoid)
    configResolution = json.dumps(configuration, separators=(",", ":"))
    osImageResolution = json.dumps(operatingSystemImage, separators=(",", ":"))
    scuResolution = json.dumps(scuImage, separators=(",", ":"))
    configMoid = configuration.get("resourceMoid") or ""
